message.content:
The belly pain and the shortness of breath started after my catheter stopped draining last night. The pain is very bad, low down in my belly, and the breathing trouble has been getting worse since then. I'm not sure how to describe the pain beyond severe, and I haven't mentioned it spreading anywhere else.

The catheter is in my urinary pouch. I had my bladder removed because of cancer, and I now have a urinary pouch that I used to catheterize through a stoma. For weeks it had been getting harder to put the catheter in, so they left a catheter in the pouch to drain all the time. Last night it stopped draining, and I've been making much less urine since.
